name: Tidewatch
goal: Launch Tidewatch, a pocket tide-table app that works fully offline, to coastal hikers and small-boat skippers who cannot rely on signal at the water.
tone: calm, practical, and trustworthy — like a harbor logbook, not a hype deck
shared_names: Tide tables in your pocket, no signal required.
facts: Works fully offline with bundled tide data for two years
